states.name: Rajasthan
states.tagline: The Land of Maharajas, Golden Sands, and Majestic Forts
states.description: Rajasthan is India's jewel of royal extravagance. Here, colossal hill forts watch over bustling bazaars resplendent with bandhani textiles, camel caravans traverse undulating dunes of the Thar, and fairytale palaces rise out of shimmered lakes in Udaipur.
culturalHighlights: Folk dances like Ghoomar and Kalbelia fire-spinning
Block-printing textiles from Sanganer and Bagru
Regal Rajputana miniature paintings and Blue Pottery
Vibrant annual fairs including Pushkar Camel Fair

famousCuisine.name: Dal Baati Churma
famousCuisine.desc: Crispy baked wheat dumplings steeped in desi ghee, paired with spicy lentils and sweet crushed jaggery wheat.

famousCuisine.name: Laal Maas
famousCuisine.desc: Fiery royal mutton curry prepared in whole Mathania red chilies and yogurt.

famousCuisine.name: Ghevar & Pyaaz Kachori
famousCuisine.desc: Honeycomb disc pastry dipped in saffron sugar syrup alongside flaky onion pastries.

attractions.name: Amber Fort
attractions.desc: Opulent yellow-sandstone fortress with Sheesh Mahal (Mirror Palace) overlooking Maota Lake.

attractions.name: Mehrangarh Fort
attractions.desc: Perched 400 feet above the Blue City, offering breathtaking ramparts and royal palanquins.

attractions.name: Lake Pichola & City Palace
attractions.desc: Marble wonder rising out of tranquil waters with views of the floating Jag Mandir.

attractions.name: Sam Sand Dunes
attractions.desc: Sunset camel safaris, desert folk camps, and stargazing under crisp desert skies.

states.travelTips: Dress modestly at temples and forts. Keep hydration handy in the daytime. Pre-book royal palace museum entry tickets to skip queues.

states.name: Kerala
states.tagline: God's Own Country of Serene Backwaters and Emerald Hills
states.description: Kerala is a tropical paradise fringed with coconut palms, tranquil lagoons, emerald tea terraces of Munnar, and centuries-old Ayurvedic heritage. Gliding on a traditional kettuvallam houseboat through Alleppey is an unforgettable experience.
culturalHighlights: Classical dance-drama Kathakali with vivid face paints
Ancient martial art form Kalaripayattu
Thrissur Pooram and majestic Vallam Kali snake boat races
Spiritual ritual performance of Theyyam in Malabar

famousCuisine.name: Appam with Vegetable Ishtu
famousCuisine.desc: Lacy fermented rice batter pancakes paired with coconut milk simmered stew.

famousCuisine.name: Kerala Sadya
famousCuisine.desc: Grand 24-course vegetarian banquet served traditionally on a fresh plantain leaf.

famousCuisine.name: Malabar Fish Curry
famousCuisine.desc: Tangy, spicy mackerel or kingfish infused with kokum and fresh ground coconut paste.

attractions.name: Alleppey Backwaters
attractions.desc: Drift along sleepy canal villages, paddy fields, and lagoons on thatched luxury houseboats.

attractions.name: Munnar Tea Plantations
attractions.desc: Rolling emerald hills carpets, tea tasting museums, and sightings of endangered Nilgiri Tahr.

attractions.name: Fort Kochi
attractions.desc: Iconic cantilevered Chinese fishing nets, Portuguese synagogues, spice markets, and art cafes.

attractions.name: Varkala Cliff Beach
attractions.desc: Dramatic coastal cliffs overlooking the Arabian Sea, yoga shalas, and natural spring waters.

states.travelTips: Book overnight houseboat stays well in advance during Dec-Jan. Respect eco-tourism guidelines in Wayanad and Periyar reserves.

states.name: Himachal Pradesh
states.tagline: Devbhoomi — The Abode of Gods, Cedar Forests & Snow Peaks
states.bestMonths: March to June & Oct to Feb
states.description: Nestled in the Western Himalayas, Himachal Pradesh boasts pine-scented valleys, turbulent glacial rivers, high-altitude passes, and Tibetan monasteries in Dharamshala. From adventurous backpacking in Parvati Valley to tranquil apple orchards in Kinnaur, it captivates every traveler.
culturalHighlights: Kullu Dussehra festival bringing hundreds of local village deities together
Tibetan Buddhist prayer wheels and butter sculptures in McLeod Ganj
Kath-Kuni architectural style made with interlocking cedar and stone
Chamba Rumal and intricate handwoven Kullu shawls

famousCuisine.name: Himachali Dham
famousCuisine.desc: Traditional celebratory meal prepared by Botis, featuring Madra (chickpeas in curd), Mah ki Dal, and Khatta.

famousCuisine.name: Siddu
famousCuisine.desc: Steamed wheat bread stuffed with spiced crushed walnuts, poppy seeds, and dipped in warm ghee.

famousCuisine.name: Tudkiya Bhath
famousCuisine.desc: Piquant Himachali one-pot pulao cooked with lentils, potatoes, cardamom, and curd.

attractions.name: Spiti Valley
attractions.desc: 1000-year-old Key Monastery, Chandratal lake, and high-altitude hamlets untouched by time.

attractions.name: Solang Valley & Rohtang
attractions.desc: Paragliding, skiing, zorbing, and breathtaking views of Pir Panjal mountain ranges.

attractions.name: Tsuglagkhang Complex
attractions.desc: Serene spiritual complex with monastery, Namgyal stupa, and Tibetan institute of performing arts.

attractions.name: Jibhi & Tirthan Valley
attractions.desc: Crystalline trout streams, cedar treehouses, and gateway to Great Himalayan National Park.

states.travelTips: Carry motion sickness meds for winding mountain passes. Layer clothing even in summer as evenings turn chilly rapidly.

states.name: Goa
states.tagline: Sun-Kissed Beaches, Portuguese Baroque Cathedrals & Susegad Spirit
states.description: India's smallest state packs world-renowned charm. From the vibrant beach clubs of North Goa to the serene, pastel-colored Latin Quarter of Fontainhas and tranquil palm shores of South Goa, its blend of Indo-Portuguese culture and relaxed 'Susegad' lifestyle is incomparable.
culturalHighlights: Goa Carnival with flamboyant street floats and mask dances
UNESCO-inscribed Baroque churches in Old Goa
Mandovi river sunset cruises with live brass bands and Konkani folk music
Cashew feni distillation traditions and spice plantation walks

famousCuisine.name: Goan Prawn Curry with Poee
famousCuisine.desc: Succulent prawns simmered in fiery coconut and red tamarind gravy served with fresh local crusty bread.

famousCuisine.name: Pork or Chicken Vindaloo
famousCuisine.desc: Portuguese-influenced dish steeped in vinegar, garlic, and Kashmiri red chilies.

famousCuisine.name: Bebinca
famousCuisine.desc: Rich traditional multi-layered Indo-Portuguese pudding made from coconut milk, egg yolks, and nutmeg.

attractions.name: Basilica of Bom Jesus
attractions.desc: 16th-century baroque architecture enshrining the mortal remains of St. Francis Xavier.

attractions.name: Palolem Beach
attractions.desc: Calm azure waters ideal for kayaking with dolphins, silent noise parties, and relaxed beach shacks.

attractions.name: Fontainhas Latin Quarter
attractions.desc: Narrow winding cobblestone alleys lined with vibrant yellow, blue, and terracotta Portuguese villas.

attractions.name: Dudhsagar Waterfalls
attractions.desc: Four-tiered roaring 310m cascade nestled in Bhagwan Mahaveer Sanctuary, crossed by railway viaduct.

states.travelTips: Renting a scooter/bike requires a valid driving license and mandatory helmet. Respect local beach swim flags indicating red safe zones.

states.name: Ladakh
states.tagline: The Land of High Passes, Blue Lakes & Starlit Celestial Skies
states.description: Ladakh is a lunar wonderland set between the Karakoram and Great Himalayas. Known for ancient cliffside Gompas, the magnetic blues of Pangong Tso, two-humped Bactrian camels in Nubra Valley, and Khardung La — one of the highest motorable roads on Earth.
culturalHighlights: Hemis Tsechu festival featuring colorful Cham mask dances
Centuries-old Thangka silk scroll paintings and brass mandalas
Unique Ladakhi Goncha woolen robes and turquoise stone jewelry
Stargazing sanctuaries and Hanle Dark Sky Reserve

famousCuisine.name: Thukpa & Tingmo
famousCuisine.desc: Steaming hot Tibetan noodle soup with local vegetables and herbs served with pillowy steamed bread.

famousCuisine.name: Chhurpi & Butter Tea (Gur Gur Chai)
famousCuisine.desc: Yak cheese delicacy accompanied by salted churned tea made with yak butter and tea leaves.

famousCuisine.name: Skyu
famousCuisine.desc: Traditional Ladakhi comfort stew made with hand-kneaded thumb dough pasta and root vegetables.

attractions.name: Pangong Tso Lake
attractions.desc: Saline lake that magically shifts shades from deep turquoise to cobalt blue against bare brown peaks.

attractions.name: Nubra Valley & Hunder Sand Dunes
attractions.desc: White dunes with double-humped Bactrian camels and the giant 32-meter Maitreya Buddha statue.

attractions.name: Thiksey Monastery
attractions.desc: Twelve-story Tibetan Buddhist complex perched commandingly over the Indus Valley.

attractions.name: Khardung La Pass
attractions.desc: Legendary mountain pass at 17,982 ft connecting the Indus Valley to the Shyok and Nubra valleys.

states.travelTips: Acclimatize in Leh for at least 48 hours before heading higher. Inner Line Permits (ILP) are mandatory for Pangong, Nubra, and Hanle.

states.name: Uttar Pradesh
states.tagline: The Heartland of Sacred Rivers, Mughal Grandeur & Living History
states.description: Uttar Pradesh is the spiritual beating heart of India. From the timeless Ganges ghats of Varanasi where evening Aarti lights up the sky, to the world wonder Taj Mahal in Agra and the Awadhi culinary legacy of Lucknow, its history runs deep.
culturalHighlights: Varanasi Ganga Aarti with grand multi-tiered brass oil lamps
Awadhi Chikankari delicate hand-embroidery from Lucknow
Classical Kathak dance originating from ancient temples
Kumbh Mela, the largest spiritual gathering on Earth

famousCuisine.name: Galouti Kebab & Sheermal
famousCuisine.desc: Melt-in-the-mouth Awadhi minced patties infused with over 100 secret spices, eaten with saffron flatbread.

famousCuisine.name: Banarasi Kachori Jalebi & Paan
famousCuisine.desc: Urad dal kachori with spiced hing aloo curry followed by crispy sweet jalebis and meetha paan.

famousCuisine.name: Agra Petha
famousCuisine.desc: Translucent candied ash gourd sweet flavoured with saffron, rose, or kewra.

attractions.name: Taj Mahal
attractions.desc: Ivory-white marble mausoleum on the south bank of the Yamuna, a sublime testament to eternal love.

attractions.name: Dashashwamedh Ghat
attractions.desc: Experience dawn boat rides witnessing spiritual life and the captivating evening Maha Aarti.

attractions.name: Bara Imambara
attractions.desc: Vast vaulted hall built without iron or wood beams, housing the famous Bhool Bhulaiya labyrinth.

attractions.name: Fatehpur Sikri
attractions.desc: Emperor Akbar's abandoned 16th-century imperial capital featuring the towering Buland Darwaza.

states.travelTips: Taj Mahal remains closed on Fridays. In Varanasi, early sunrise boat rides (5:30 AM) offer the most serene perspective of the ghats.

states.name: Meghalaya
states.tagline: The Abode of Clouds, Living Root Bridges & Crystalline Rivers
states.description: Perched in the lush northeastern hills, Meghalaya is famous for bio-engineered living root bridges crafted by the Khasi tribe, Cherrapunji's roaring waterfalls, the glass-like waters of the Umngot River in Dawki, and Asia's cleanest village Mawlynnong.
culturalHighlights: Matrilineal lineage traditions of the Khasi, Garo, and Jaintia tribes
Indigenous bio-engineering of Ficus elastica living root bridges
Shillong Cherry Blossom Festival and vibrant indie rock music culture
Bamboo and cane basketry and handwoven Ryndia silk

famousCuisine.name: Jadoh with Dohkhleh
famousCuisine.desc: Fragrant short-grain rice cooked in rich meat stock served with refreshing pork and onion salad.

famousCuisine.name: Tungrymbai
famousCuisine.desc: Fermented soybean paste sautéed with pork, black sesame seeds, and local ginger.

famousCuisine.name: Pukhlein
famousCuisine.desc: Crispy deep-fried sweet Khasi rice flour treats sweetened with jaggery.

attractions.name: Double Decker Living Root Bridge
attractions.desc: Trek down 3,500 stone stairs through rainforest to witness two-tier living root bridges spanning river rapids.

attractions.name: Dawki & Umngot River
attractions.desc: Emerald river water so crystalline that wooden canoes appear to float suspended in air.

attractions.name: Nohkalikai Falls
attractions.desc: Stunning 340-meter single drop waterfall plunging into an electric green pool amid misty cliffs.

attractions.name: Mawlynnong Village
attractions.desc: Renowned as Asia's cleanest village, featuring immaculate floral lanes and treehouse lookouts.

states.travelTips: Carry sturdy waterproof trekking shoes for Nongriat root bridges. Rain gear is essential throughout the year.

states.name: Tamil Nadu
states.tagline: Dravidian Temple Towers, Carnatic Rhythms & French Boulevards
states.description: Tamil Nadu is the heartland of Dravidian art and temple architecture, home to towering sculpted Gopurams, ancient bronze casting, classical Bharatanatyam dance, Nilgiri hill railways, and the tranquil seaside promenades of coastal heritage.
culturalHighlights: Classical Bharatanatyam dance traditions and December Carnatic Music Season
Brihadeeswara Temple and Great Living Chola Temples
Chettinad mansion architecture and Tanjore gold foil paintings
Kanchipuram pure mulberry silk sarees handwoven with zari borders

famousCuisine.name: Chettinad Chicken Pepper Curry
famousCuisine.desc: Deeply aromatic gravy flavored with star anise, stone flower (kalpasi), black peppercorns, and coconut.

famousCuisine.name: Crispy Ghee Roast Dosa with Sambar
famousCuisine.desc: Golden paper-thin fermented crepe cooked in pure ghee paired with drumstick sambar and coconut chutneys.

famousCuisine.name: Filter Kaapi & Jigarthanda
famousCuisine.desc: Frothy degree chicory filter coffee served in brass davarah alongside Madurai's famous cooling almond gum dessert.

attractions.name: Meenakshi Amman Temple
attractions.desc: Vast temple city with 14 soaring gopurams encrusted with thousands of painted mythological figures.

attractions.name: Shore Temple & Pancha Rathas
attractions.desc: 7th-century coastal rock-cut temples standing resilient against the crashing Bay of Bengal waves.

attractions.name: Nilgiri Mountain Railway
attractions.desc: Charming meter-gauge toy train winding through 208 curves, 16 tunnels, and fragrant eucalyptus slopes.

attractions.name: Dhanushkodi Ghost Town
attractions.desc: Spectacular sandspit where the Indian Ocean meets the Bay of Bengal, steeped in Ramayana lore.

states.travelTips: Dress code rules strictly mandate modest attire (no shorts or sleeveless tops) inside historic temples like Meenakshi Amman.

states.name: Andhra Pradesh
states.tagline: Tirupati Balaji Abode, Araku Coffee Valleys & Kalamkari Art
states.description: Home to the revered hill shrine of Tirumala Venkateswara, the breathtaking Araku Valley, Borra Caves, and the serene beaches of Visakhapatnam.

states.name: Arunachal Pradesh
states.tagline: The Land of the Dawn-Lit Mountains & Tawang Monastery
states.description: India's easternmost frontier where the sun first rises, featuring Tawang Monastery, Sela Pass, and the pristine wilderness of Namdapha National Park.

states.name: Assam
states.tagline: The Realm of the Great One-Horned Rhino & World's Finest Tea
states.description: Famed for Kaziranga and Manas national parks, the mighty Brahmaputra river, Majuli river island, and golden Muga silk.

states.name: Bihar
states.tagline: The Cradle of Buddhism & Ancient Nalanda University
states.description: Where Gautama Buddha attained enlightenment beneath the Bodhi Tree in Bodh Gaya, and ancient scholars gathered at Nalanda.

states.name: Chhattisgarh
states.tagline: India's Niagara at Chitrakote & Tribal Heritage Bastar
states.description: Dense sal forests, Chitrakote horseshoe falls on the Indravati river, and Bastar bell metal craft traditions.

states.name: Gujarat
states.tagline: White Rann of Kutch, Asiatic Lions & Vibrant Garba
states.description: Vast white salt desert illuminated under the full moon during Rann Utsav, Gir National Park lions, and Mahatma Gandhi's Sabarmati Ashram.

states.name: Haryana
states.tagline: Epic Battlefield of Kurukshetra & Surajkund Crafts
states.description: Historic sites of the Mahabharata, Sultanpur bird sanctuary, and the vibrant Surajkund International Crafts Mela.

states.name: Jharkhand
states.tagline: The Land of Forests, Roaring Waterfalls & Betla Wildlife
states.description: Famous for scenic waterfalls like Hundru and Dassam, Parasnath Jain temples, and lush tribal homelands.

states.name: Karnataka
states.tagline: The Boulders of Hampi, Coorg Coffee & Royal Mysore
states.description: UNESCO Vijayanagara ruins at Hampi, illuminated Mysore Palace during Dasara, coffee mist in Coorg, and Gokarna beaches.

states.name: Madhya Pradesh
states.tagline: The Tiger State & Khajuraho's Sculpted Marvels
states.description: Bandhavgarh and Kanha tiger safaris, Khajuraho erotic temples, Sanchi Buddhist stupa, and Gwalior fort.

states.name: Maharashtra
states.tagline: Gateway of India, Ajanta-Ellora Caves & Sahyadri Treks
states.description: Mumbai's colonial Art Deco and Bollywood glamour, rock-cut Ajanta and Ellora caves, and misty monsoon Western Ghats.

states.name: Manipur
states.tagline: Floating Phumdis of Loktak Lake & Sangai Deer
states.description: World's only floating national park on Loktak Lake, Kangla Fort, and graceful classical Manipuri Raas Leela dance.

states.name: Mizoram
states.tagline: Rolling Blue Hills, Cheraw Bamboo Dance & Pristine Mist
states.description: Known as the Land of Blue Mountains (Phawngpui), featuring bamboo dance festivals and hilltop church architecture.

states.name: Nagaland
states.tagline: The Hornbill Festival & Emerald Dzukou Valley
states.description: Famous for the Hornbill Festival celebrating 16 indigenous tribes, Dzukou Valley bamboo treks, and scenic Naga hills.

states.name: Odisha
states.tagline: Konark Sun Temple, Puri Jagannath Rath & Chilika Lake
states.description: Chariot architecture at Konark Sun Temple, sacred Rath Yatra in Puri, and dolphin boat cruises in Asia's largest brackish lagoon Chilika.

states.name: Punjab
states.tagline: The Golden Temple of Amritsar, Bhangra & Hearty Hospitality
states.description: The radiant Golden Temple (Sri Harmandir Sahib) serving free langar to 100,000 pilgrims daily, Wagah Border retreat ceremony, and yellow mustard fields.

states.name: Sikkim
states.tagline: Kangchenjunga Guardian, Organic Wonderland & High Passes
states.bestMonths: March to May & Oct to Dec
states.description: India's first fully organic state beneath the third-highest mountain Kangchenjunga, featuring Nathu La pass and Gurudongmar Lake.

states.name: Telangana
states.tagline: Charminar, Golconda Diamonds & World-Famous Biryani
states.description: Hyderabad's historic Charminar, acoustic marvels of Golconda Fort, Ramoji Film City, and iconic Hyderabadi Dum Biryani.

states.name: Tripura
states.tagline: Ujjayanta Palace, Neermahal Water Castle & Unakoti Rock Carvings
states.description: Neermahal palace surrounded by Rudrasagar Lake and the colossal bas-relief stone carvings of Lord Shiva at Unakoti.

states.name: Uttarakhand
states.tagline: Yoga Capital Rishikesh, Valley of Flowers & Char Dham
states.bestMonths: March to June & Sep to Nov
states.description: World Capital of Yoga in Rishikesh, UNESCO Valley of Flowers carpeted in alpine blooms, Jim Corbett tigers, and ski slopes of Auli.

states.name: West Bengal
states.tagline: Durga Puja Carnivals, Darjeeling Toy Train & Sundarban Mangroves
states.description: The cultural city of Kolkata with Victoria Memorial, Darjeeling tea gardens with Everest views, and Sundarbans Royal Bengal tiger mangroves.

states.name: Andaman & Nicobar Islands
states.tagline: Radhanagar Turquoise Waters, Coral Reefs & Cellular Jail
states.description: Pristine white sand beaches on Havelock Island (Swaraj Dweep), scuba diving with sea turtles, and national historic memorial Cellular Jail.

states.name: Chandigarh
states.tagline: The City Beautiful, Le Corbusier Architecture & Rock Garden
states.description: India's premier planned city, Nek Chand's recycled art Rock Garden, and Sukhna Lake promenades.

states.name: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
states.tagline: Portuguese Coastal Bastions, Nagoa Beach & Quiet Shres
states.description: Historic seaside forts of Moti Daman and Diu Fort, peaceful palm-fringed coastlines, and colonial chapels.

states.name: Delhi
states.tagline: The Historic Capital, Qutub Minar, Red Fort & Chandni Chowk Food
states.description: Sprawling metropolis housing Humayun's Tomb, India Gate, culinary labyrinth of Old Delhi, and grand Rajpath boulevard.

states.name: Jammu & Kashmir
states.tagline: Paradise on Earth, Dal Lake Shikaras & Gulmarg Snow
states.bestMonths: March to October & Dec to Feb
states.description: Gliding on ornate wooden Shikaras in Dal Lake, skiing down powdery Gulmarg slopes, and saffron gardens of Pampore.

states.name: Lakshadweep
states.tagline: Pristine Coral Atolls, Bangaram Lagoons & Snorkeling Heaven
states.description: Secluded archipelago of 36 islands boasting untouched turquoise lagoons, vibrant coral reefs, and water sports.

states.name: Puducherry
states.tagline: French Quarter Bougainvillea, Auroville & Seaside Promenade
states.description: Mustard-yellow French colonial architecture, bicycle-friendly streets, experimental township Auroville, and seaside cafes.

winter.name: Winter (Nov – Feb)
winter.tagline: Crisp Golden Days, Desert Fairs & Snowy Mountain Slopes
winter.climateSummary: Ideal sunny weather across Rajasthan, Central & South India. Heavy snowfall in Kashmir and Himachal.
winter.packingTips: Heavy woolens for Himalayas; light layers and shawls for Rajasthan/Delhi; light cottons for Goa and Kerala.

festivals.name: Pushkar Camel Fair
festivals.desc: World's largest livestock fair with folk music, turban tying competitions, and hot air balloons.

festivals.name: Rann Utsav
festivals.desc: White salt desert carnival with tent cities, Kutchi embroidery stalls, and full-moon camel rides.

festivals.name: Hornbill Festival
festivals.desc: The Festival of Festivals uniting all 16 Naga tribes for indigenous dances, warrior games, and feastings.

festivals.name: Sunburn / Goa Music Festivals
festivals.desc: Vibrant beach parties, Christmas Eve fireworks, and midnight masses in historic Old Goa churches.

summer.name: Summer (Mar – June)
summer.tagline: Cool Alpine Meadows, High Pass Road Trips & Roaring Glacial Rivers
summer.climateSummary: Warm and sunny across the central and southern plains; crisp, pleasant, and accessible in high-altitude Himalayas.
summer.packingTips: Sunscreen, sunglasses, breathable cottons for sightseeing; light fleece jacket for high passes like Khardung La & Rohtang.

festivals.name: Hemis Festival
festivals.desc: Celebration of Guru Padmasambhava with sacred Cham mask dances and huge silk Thangka displays.

festivals.name: Baisakhi
festivals.desc: Harvest festival filled with lively Bhangra, Gidda, and colorful fairs at the Golden Temple.

festivals.name: Ooty Flower Show
festivals.desc: Exhibition of exotic orchids, bonsai, and millions of cut flowers in the Nilgiri Government Botanical Garden.

monsoon.name: Monsoon (July – Sep)
monsoon.tagline: Thunderous Waterfalls, Emerald Terrains & Ayurvedic Rejuvenation
monsoon.climateSummary: Southwest monsoon drenches the subcontinent, turning the Western Ghats and Meghalaya into dramatic rainforests.
monsoon.packingTips: Sturdy waterproof backpack, quick-dry clothes, umbrella, rain poncho, and mosquito repellent.

festivals.name: Onam
festivals.desc: Harvest homecoming of King Mahabali celebrated with floral Pookkalams, Sadya feasts, and snake boat races.

festivals.name: Ganesh Chaturthi
festivals.desc: Grand 10-day celebration in Mumbai with towering Ganesha idols, Dhol-Tasha drumming, and beach immersions.

festivals.name: Teej Festival
festivals.desc: Celebration of monsoon welcoming Parvati with swings hung from banyan trees, Ghevar sweets, and green lehengas.

autumn.name: Autumn (October)
autumn.tagline: Post-Monsoon Clearness, Reopened Tiger Parks & Grand Festivities
autumn.climateSummary: Skies clear up to reveal vibrant blue horizons. Temperatures turn pleasantly mild before winter chill arrives.
autumn.packingTips: Comfortable walking shoes, daylight casuals, light cardigan or stole for cooler evenings.

festivals.name: Durga Puja
festivals.desc: UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage: thousands of magnificent themed art pandals, Dhunuchi dance, and festive fervor.

festivals.name: Mysuru Dasara
festivals.desc: Centuries-old royal procession featuring the golden howdah carried by caparisoned elephants and 100,000 bulbs illuminating the Palace.

festivals.name: Diwali (Festival of Lights)
festivals.desc: Millions of clay diyas, fireworks, rangoli patterns, and exchange of sweets celebrating the victory of light over darkness.

stays.name: Zostel Jaipur (M.I. Road)
stays.proximity: 10 mins walk from Hawa Mahal & Old Pink City Bazaars

stays.name: The Hosteller Manali (Old Manali)
stays.proximity: Nestled in cedar woods, 5 mins from Manu Temple

stays.name: Madpackers Rishikesh (Laxman Jhula)
stays.proximity: Overlooking the holy river Ganga, 300m from Laxman Jhula

stays.name: Anjuna Beach Backpacker Shack & Hostel
stays.proximity: 2 minutes barefoot stroll from Anjuna Flea Market & Beach

stays.name: Heritage Haveli Khas
stays.proximity: Direct unobstructed view of Mehrangarh Fort ramparts

stays.name: Backwater Breeze Heritage Homestay
stays.proximity: Located right on the tranquil Vembanad Lake canals

stays.name: Coorg Arabica Coffee Plantation Cottage
stays.proximity: Surrounded by 40 acres of private spice and coffee trees

stays.name: Nongriat Living Roots Forest Eco-Lodge
stays.proximity: 15 minutes hike from the Double Decker Living Root Bridge

stays.name: The Oberoi Udaivilas / Taj Lake Palace Experience
stays.proximity: Spanning 50 acres on the banks of historic Lake Pichola

stays.name: Kumarakom Lake Resort & Ayurvedic Sanctuary
stays.proximity: Nestled on pristine backwaters, prince-tested luxury

stays.name: Wildflower Hall, An Oberoi Resort in the Himalayas
amenities: Heated Outdoor Whirlpool with Snow Views
stays.proximity: 8,250 feet above sea level with panoramic Greater Himalayan views

stays.name: Taj Exotica Resort & Spa
stays.proximity: Fronting the untouched white sands of Benaulim South Goa

backpacker.label: Backpacker / Budget Explorer
backpacker.description: Dorm beds & cozy hostels, authentic street food & dhabas, public transit (metro, sleeper trains & state buses), self-guided exploration.

midrange.label: Comfortable Mid-Range
midrange.description: Private rooms in boutique homestays or 3-star heritage inns, quality local restaurants & cafes, AC trains & private cabs, guided monument tours.

luxury.label: Royal & Luxury Connoisseur
luxury.description: 5-star heritage palaces and premium eco-resorts, fine dining & royal banquets, dedicated private chauffeur vehicles, VIP passes & private wildlife safaris.

metro-heritage.label: Heritage & Golden Triangle (Delhi, Jaipur, Agra, Varanasi)
